links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease score (readability) of chatbot responses about smile design
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 responses were the most readable (P<.05); however, all models produced output classified as difficult to read.

links.outcome: Presence of source citations in chatbot responses

links.quote: Only Copilot and Gemini included source citations in their responses.
